title: ResourceSearch results: support both RESOURCE_TABLE and FIELD_VALUES formats
answers: How do I handle ResourceSearchResponse when some servers return RESOURCE_TABLE and others FIELD_VALUES?
Why does my search-result consumer break on older IAM servers?
Pattern for decoding resourcepb.ResourceSearchResponse across result formats
body:
Symptom: a handler that assumes `result.Results.Rows` (RESOURCE_TABLE) breaks or silently loses permission/external data when the backend is switched to key-only `FIELD_VALUES` results, or vice versa when talking to an older server.
Root cause: resourcepb.ResourceSearchResponse can carry rows in two shapes: `Results.Rows` ([]*ResourceTableRow with inline Cells, legacy adapter) or `Rows` ([]*ResourceSearchRow, key-only). Code that reads only one shape mishandles the other.
Fix pattern: switch on `result.GetResultFormat()` (UNSPECIFIED/RESOURCE_TABLE vs FIELD_VALUES) in a single decode function that normalizes both into a common internal row type (key, sortFields, optional inline permission/external + an `inline` flag); downstream logic branches on that flag instead of on result format directly. See pkg/registry/apis/iam/user/rest_user_team.go:decodeUserTeamSearchRows and userTeamSearchRow.
Constraints: applies to any new consumer of ResourceSearchClient.Search results; when sending the request, also set `ResultFormat` and `Fields` explicitly (e.g. `resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES` + `Fields: []string{resource.SEARCH_FIELD_NAME}`) — FIELD_VALUES rows never carry inline cell data (permission/external), so code must fall back to a separate fetch (e.g. Team Get) when `inline` is false. Unknown result formats should error rather than silently return empty.
applies: any consumer of resourcepb.ResourceSearchClient.Search responses that may receive either RESOURCE_TABLE or FIELD_VALUES result formats
says: Why does search handler break when server switches the result format?
Handler works fine on old servers but fails on new versions
How do I decode search results that might be either format?
Switching servers loses permission data in downstream search result handlers
What pattern handles both legacy and current resource search formats correctly?
search: ResourceSearch responses may contain either RESOURCE_TABLE (Results.Rows with inline permission/external data) or FIELD_VALUES (key-only Rows) results; handlers assuming only one shape silently lose data across format changes or server upgrades. Decode using a single function that switches on ResultFormat (as in pkg/registry/apis/iam/user/rest_user_team.go:decodeUserTeamSearchRows), normalizes both shapes into a common row type with an inline flag, and branches downstream logic on that flag instead of result format. When requesting FIELD_VALUES, set ResultFormat and Fields explicitly and fetch missing inline data separately (e.g., via Team Get).
